_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: These long-term contracts are typically structured with a fixed fee reserving the right to transport or store natural gas and specify that we receive the majority of our fee for making the capacity available, whether or not the customer actually chooses to utilize that capacity. Risk factor: Sharp declines in the prices of crude oil, NGL or natural gas, or a prolonged unfavorable price environment, may result in a commensurate reduction in our revenues, income and cash flows from our businesses that produce, process, or purchase and sell crude oil, NGL, or natural gas, and could have a material adverse effect on the carrying value (which includes assigned goodwill) of our CO2 business segment’s proved reserves, certain assets in certain midstream businesses within our Natural Gas Pipelines business segment, and certain assets within our Products Pipelines business segment.; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the CO2 segment owns working interests in oil fields and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Kinder Morgan

theme_watch.reason: Live: Kinder Morgan's own FY2024 10-K says 'We also own and operate oil and gas producing fields, and RNG, LNG and landfill GTE facilities.' and, of greenhouse gas laws and regulations, 'Such laws or regulations could also lead to reduced demand for hydrocarbon products that are deemed to contribute to emissions of GHGs, or restrictions on their use, which in turn could adversely affect demand for our products and services.' The stock trades at 21.8x FY25E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ENERGY_TRANSITION) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing decarbonisation of Kinder Morgan's oil reserves and the hydrocarbons its pipelines carry specifically.

classification.quality_note: These long-term contracts are typically structured with a fixed fee reserving the right to transport or store natural gas and specify that we receive the majority of our fee for making the capacity available, whether or not the customer actually chooses to utilize that capacity. Risk factor: Sharp declines in the prices of crude oil, NGL or natural gas, or a prolonged unfavorable price environment, may result in a commensurate reduction in our revenues, income and cash flows from our businesses that produce, process, or purchase and sell crude oil, NGL, or natural gas, and could have a material adverse effect on the carrying value (which includes assigned goodwill) of our CO2 business segment’s proved reserves, certain assets in certain midstream businesses within our Natural Gas Pipelines business segment, and certain assets within our Products Pipelines business segment.; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the CO2 segment owns working interests in oil fields and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Kinder Morgan. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.76x; +36% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.10; conservative 2yr -4%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.4%/yr (worst year FY14-FY24 ex-FY15 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -7.8%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.1-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY20 median

BULL.desc: EPS +2.8%/yr (FY14-FY24 ex-FY15 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY20 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY24 ex-FY15 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY20, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2025-01-31) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.76x (34.5% downside to Bear $18 / +9.2% upside to Bull $30) | Adj composite 2.29 vs market 3.39: gap -1.10 [OVERVALUED] | +36% above the EPP floor $20 (16x FY25E $1.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: -4.3% total (-2.1%/yr) | At 21.8x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $36 sits above the BULL case; segment EBDA +2.5% and Natural Gas Pipelines +2.9% in Q4 2024, forward revenues -1.3% (no FY25 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2024 revenues as reported); the energy transition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
